title: fix(qa): verify settled handoffs on the visible transcript branch
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: the QA subagent-handoff scenario times out after a successful child completion when transcript metadata separates delivery from the requester’s reply.

## User Impact

QA runs recognize the completed handoff while continuing to reject replies from another turn or transcript branch. No configuration changes or migrations are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the history owner’s active transcript selection instead of walking raw parent IDs, then require the matching settlement, visible assistant identity, and exact child result. Raw append ancestry can cross a side append into an earlier turn; the canonical selection keeps that branch distinction intact. This removes the separate parent-ID set; production grows by 27 net lines to reuse the owner and preserve ordering barriers.

Adapts Free Wortley’s branch-selection approach from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/181239, with co-author credit. That branch is not maintainer-editable; this replacement preserves the current verbatim-result handling and turn/control boundaries.

## Evidence

- Reproduced the original timeout through an isolated Gateway on both pinned OpenAI and Anthropic mock-provider routes; the final requester reply was present but was not recognized.
- The metadata regression failed on the base. An additional SQLite-backed side-append regression caught an incorrect raw-parent traversal and now passes through the actual transcript writer/reader.
- Both affected suites pass: 50 tests, about 62 seconds including compilation. The test growth allocation records 123 net lines.
- On the final source bytes, both isolated Gateway handoff replays pass all four steps, including the child result in the requester’s final reply. These use the QA channel and mock providers, not external live services. Eleven unaffected cases passed in the earlier agentic pack; only the failed handoff surface was replayed after the final change.
- Targeted typecheck, lint, formatting, SDK export consistency, and the private-QA runtime build pass.
- Fresh independent diff review: no findings. Full local ClawSweeper review of base `f78c52904233e7f9f1b03a5c2235ddb0b116ed9b` through head `9bfc4de59fc1f6c58b1e4ee83a90f50f0b15507a`: complete, all five changed files covered, no actionable correctness or security findings.

CI: [run41215870537, attempt1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41215870537) failed only `checks-node-changed-2`: the refusal product-proof test expects the generic notice retired by [188462](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/188462). Its test, formatter, notice writer, and history projection have identical Git blobs on the inspected CI baseline and tested merge; this handoff change does not call that refusal path. `security-fast` passed. This inherited failure remains failed and is handled through the native pre-existing-failure exception; the stale refusal expectation is a separate follow-up.
